invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破630（基于ATR 4.81和支撑），或融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 630 (based on ATR 4.81 and support), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases).
